scope: Source-chain documentary audit only. No production edits, Git/network/physical connections, or File output recording review. No claim that the 0.14 implementation is complete.

registrationLedger.note: Original ledger classifies immutable 0.12, not 0.13 implementation reachability.

portableContractAdvice.providerTarget: Concrete action provider on captured valid axis, whether or not selected for output.
portableContractAdvice.sameValue: No setter-driven notification on ordinary equal assignments under default Fody behavior; explicit Reset and Reload still execute.
portableContractAdvice.motionReset: Explicit optional sync (default true) before Time=0,index=-1,playing=true; UI Reset has no explicit sync.
portableContractAdvice.duration: Setter preserves points, requests sync and marks refresh through dependent Viewport. An attached canvas can remove shared out-of-viewport points; do not unconditionally apply that to hidden providers.
portableContractAdvice.playByName: First Name OR FullName OrdinalIgnoreCase exact match in existing connected Internal playlist; same index pathway; preserve paused/playing state.
portableContractAdvice.shortcutEnabled: First exact ordinal name, including original null-name match. Changes future gesture admission only; current batch and existing timers are not canceled.
portableContractAdvice.reload: ResetSync before search; no lock bypass. Non-priority miss link-fallback first, found resources next, priority links last.
portableContractAdvice.resourceIdentity: Compare original interface resource reference, not record/content equality. Every non-null LinkTo creates a new wrapper.
portableContractAdvice.viewDependentLimits: RangeSlider MinRange .01; Random editor Octaves max8; Duration attached canvas normalization. These do not universally constrain headless callbacks.
portableContractAdvice.validation: Defaults and saved typed values numeric-template clamp; direct typed Invoke does not. Strict finite JSON rejection is a documented portable policy.

source.callbackSource: name => WhenConnected(() => { var playlist = ScriptPlaylist; if (playlist == null) return; var index = playlist.FindIndex(name); if (index >= 0) WriteMessage(new PlayScriptAtIndexMessage(index)); })

definition.partial: A known original argument, expansion, dependency, runtime budget, or loaded-binding effect remains restricted/not reproduced. It is wired but must not be advertised as complete original behavior.
definition.unwired: No current catalog+real-handler route; no credit for existing underlying model.

candidate014.sharedEditorAdaptations: Legacy/nonzero defaults and selected-axis sentinel are retained and disclosed per entry; they are not exact source action-editor default parity.

wpfProgrammaticBindingEvidence.conclusion: In the loaded/bound WPF view, source property notifications update Value/IsChecked/SelectedItem/SelectedValue. Their ordinary change events reach the registered handlers for programmatic assignments too: no pointer/user-origin check exists. NonReloadingTabControl creates/preserves presenters for all axes. Same-value assignments need not raise a change. This is source-backed binding-path analysis, not execution of WPF controls on OHOS. Preserve these effects in owning session/pipeline configuration; no command-origin suppression exception.
